SBI Caps to begin metro valuation in July

SBI Capital Markets (SBI Caps) is set to commence the valuation of metro projects in July. This process is a key step in the financial assessment of these infrastructure developments. The valuation is expected to provide clarity on the financial standing and future prospects of metro projects.
